description: This file declares functions for computing dot products and average power of complex and arithmetic spans, including specialized functions for complex types with conjugation and different precisions.

methods.name: dot_prod
methods.description: Computes the dot product of two spans of arithmetic types with an initial value.

methods.name: dot_prod
methods.description: Computes the dot product of two complex spans, conjugating the second span.

methods.name: dot_prod
methods.description: Computes the dot product of a complex span and a brain float span.

methods.name: dot_prod
methods.description: Computes the dot product of a brain float span and a complex span.

methods.name: average_power
methods.description: Estimates the average power of a complex span in linear scale.

methods.name: average_power
methods.description: Estimates the average power of a brain float complex span in linear scale.
